Claude Code managed hook overlay (darwin)

Emits only hooks.PreToolUse with matcher *.
Hook command: '/opt/preloop/bin/preloop' agents permission-hook --source claude-code
Host timeout: 300 seconds
Reviewed delivery target: /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json

This export is offline and performs no installation or enrollment.
Provision the per-device/user hook credential separately through supported onboarding.
Missing credentials deny under the existing permission-hook contract.
The application honoring this overlay remains unverified. A higher managed source may supersede it.
Managed configuration is not device attestation or local-admin immunity.

Omitted: model routing, MCP allowlists, permission rules, OTel, credentials, Codex, Desktop.
Review manifest.json and docs/guide/clients/claude-code.md before delivery.
